dedupe_keys.name: agera5 agrometeorological indicators copernicus climate data store

description: AgERA5 is a global dataset of daily surface meteorological indicators prepared for agriculture and agro-ecological modelling, with about 16 variables such as minimum and maximum temperature, precipitation, wind speed, solar radiation, humidity, evapotranspiration and snow. It is produced by the Copernicus Climate Change Service at ECMWF from the ERA5 reanalysis, aggregated to local-time daily values and corrected to a finer grid using regressions trained on ECMWF's high-resolution model. Coverage is global at 0.1 by 0.1 degree, daily from 1979 to the present, updated daily, with versions 1.1 and 2.0. Files are NetCDF-4 following the CF 1.7 conventions, downloaded free through the Climate Data Store web form or API after registering, under a CC BY licence. Caveats: values are reanalysis estimates, not station observations, so local extremes and precipitation in complex terrain can be biased, and results differ between versions. For simulation it drives crop, drought and heat stress models and supplies weather inputs for climate adaptation studies of farms, irrigation and the energy and water systems that serve them. It is related to the Copernicus Climate Data Store record in this catalogue, the platform that serves it.
